dataset_title: South Holland roadside green-area inventory: grouped area and maintenance summary
source_title: Areaal beheer - Groen - groenobjecten langs de provinciale wegen en vaarwegen in beheer van de provincie Zuid-Holland
geography: South Holland, Netherlands; provincial roads and waterways under provincial management
license: Public domain, as stated by the national open-data catalog

processing.filters_note: All 37,188 published feature records were retrieved as attributes only. The summary retains roadside berms, grass-paving blocks and sightline areas separately; it does not spatially screen geometry or infer grass cover.

limitations: This is a grouping of public administrative inventory attributes, not a measured grass crop or harvested-material dataset.

Mapped polygon area and slope-corrected area do not establish grass fraction, accessible area, harvest rights, collection efficiency, cut-level mass, dry matter, composition, delivered supply or plant capacity.
Sightline areas and grass-paving blocks are not assumed to be collectible feedstock; even berms require geometry, vegetation, ecological, access and contract screening.
The source label 'met meter maaien' is retained verbatim; its operational/English meaning has not been verified.
Maintenance frequency is preserved as a source label and is not treated as a measured harvest frequency or annual yield.
No GreenHub default, parameter-registry value, feedstock-resolution rule or scenario input is activated by this reference table.

provenance.query_mode: WFS GetFeature; attribute-only; bounded request covering the published 37,188 features
provenance.transformation: Grouped selected source attributes and summed the two published area fields; no unit conversion or yield calculation was applied.
